findings.title: An Arabic hint on the wrong side of the field
findings.message: The placeholder "اكتب رسالتك..." is Arabic in a left-to-right field.
findings.fix: Keep dir="ltr" for what people type, and right-align the Arabic hint with input:placeholder-shown { direction: rtl } or ::placeholder { text-align: right }.
findings.snippet: <textarea id="messageInput" name="message" rows="1" placeholder="اكتب رسالتك..." dir="auto" autocomplete="off"></textarea>

findings.title: Two digit systems on one screen
findings.message: "TX-48213" uses a different digit system from the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Pick one digit system for the product and format every number with it.

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: "Noto Sans Arabic" is named but never loaded.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: Position, float or border that does not mirror
findings.message: border-top-left-radius: 18px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use inset-inline-start, float: inline-start, border-inline-start and border-start-start-radius.
findings.snippet: مرحبًا، طلبت شريحة eSIM جديدة أمس ولم تصلني رسالة التفعيل.
